spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin after a new 20-day high where the prior marker was at least 3 sessions earlier and the close exceeds it, entering at the prior watermark and exiting within 2-6 bars.
assumptions: Timeframe 1d taken from page chart, not stated in claim text.
Direction long because claim states Buy entry; low-breakout short side not compiled.

Next-day entry at prior watermark compiled as breakout close with next-open fill, which is how the engine fills; exact stop-entry price level is NOT EXPRESSIBLE: schema has no stop-entry-at-prior-watermark order type.

At-least-3-sessions gap compiled as no breakout on each of the 3 prior bars: close[1] <= 20-bar high[1] AND close[2] <= 20-bar high[2] AND close[3] <= 20-bar high[3], so the broken marker stood for at least 3 sessions.
Close beyond previous marker compiled as close gt highest_high(20) where highest_high looks at previous 20 bars excluding current bar.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: exact stop location below the latest triggering high/low cannot be expressed as a fixed percent or ATR multiple; no fixed stop is set and exit relies on timed exit within 2-6 bars.

evidence.quote: Buy entry is placed on the next day
The market makes a new 20day high or low
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
Profits/exits should be taken within 2-6 candlestick intervals

audit_majors: entry: Claim triggers on 'a new 20day high or low' with a Buy entry at the prior high/low watermark. Spec encodes only the new 20-day high breakout (close > 20-bar highest high with 3-bar gap) and has no entry leg for the symmetric new 20-day low breakout leading to a buy.
